description: This file contains implementation of engine control logic, including warning management, fuel consumption calculations, engine state updates, sensor readings, and startup fuel pumping routines for an engine management system.

classes.name: WarningCodeState
classes.description: Manages warning codes, including adding warnings, clearing, and checking warning status.

classes.name: MockAdcState
classes.description: Simulates ADC readings for testing purposes.

classes.name: FuelConsumptionState
classes.description: Tracks fuel consumption over time, updating per second and per minute.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Maintains engine operational state, including sensor updates and periodic callbacks.

classes.name: SensorsState
classes.description: Holds sensor data, including mock sensor values.

classes.name: StartupFuelPumping
classes.description: Controls startup fuel priming pulses based on engine RPM and throttle position.

methods.name: WarningCodeState::clear
methods.description: Resets warning counters and recent warnings.

methods.name: WarningCodeState::addWarningCode
methods.description: Adds a warning code to the warning state.

methods.name: WarningCodeState::isWarningNow
methods.description: Checks if a warning is active based on timing and indicator type.

methods.name: MockAdcState::setMockVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage for a specific ADC channel.

methods.name: FuelConsumptionState::addData
methods.description: Adds duration data to fuel consumption calculations.

methods.name: FuelConsumptionState::update
methods.description: Updates fuel consumption rates based on elapsed time.

methods.name: EngineState::updateSlowSensors
methods.description: Updates engine sensors with current readings.

methods.name: EngineState::periodicFastCallback
methods.description: Performs fast periodic engine state updates, including sensor readings, fuel calculations, and engine parameters.

methods.name: EngineState::updateTChargeK
methods.description: Updates the charge air temperature estimate based on current engine conditions.

methods.name: StartupFuelPumping::setPumpsCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter for startup fuel priming pulses.

methods.name: StartupFuelPumping::update
methods.description: Updates startup fuel priming based on engine RPM and throttle position.
